firstPlayerRule: Nobody goes first: everyone looks at their hand, then all players pass one card to the left at the same time.
interpretation: The page describes everyone passing together rather than in turn; this site reads that as simultaneous play.

sources.title: Pig: How to Play

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards page in a browser. "The players look at their hands; then each player passes one card to the left and picks up the card passed by the player on their right."
